facts.value: ASU Health Services offers many health care services to ASU students, including primary care, immunizations, women’s health care, lab services and much more.
Medical care is available on ASU campuses provided by board-certified doctors and nurse practitioners on all four metro Phoenix campuses.
All ASU students get automatic membership to the Sun Devil Fitness Complex, which offers weights, cardio and exercise classes on each campus.
Affordable medical insurance is available through ASU.
You can combat the freshman 15 by making smart food choices and getting regular exercise.
